title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selections were made by comparing product mentions across Consumer Reports, CNET, PCMag, Reviewed, TechGearLab, and BonAppetit. Products cited by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are omitted unless explicitly stated in a source; only the prices given in BonAppetit were included.

verdict.line: Picture a busy kitchen where you need a reliable, odor‑sealed bin that opens with a foot pedal. The Simplehuman can locks in smells, has a smooth step‑lift lid, and is praised for its durability. The catch: it is pricier than some alternatives.
